title: Trigram code fragment 'Suite du No 13 / No 24', BL Add MS 32280 f. 3 (DECODE R8871)

documents.shelfmark: BL Add MS 32280 f. 3; DECODE R8871

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf, on DECODE or among the volume's key records.

transcription.notes: Three-character groups on a ruled form; uncertain at b/6, 9/g, 1/l, r/v.

system.summary: Three-character groups of letters, digits and oe; flat character statistics and one repeat in 77 groups suggest a large or enciphered code.
system.notes: Heading 'Suite du No 13' / 'No 24' in French; companion R8870 (ff. 1-2) is an unrelated numeric code letter.

prior_solution.where: none found on DECODE or among the 26 key records of Add MS 32280

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Downloaded R8871 and companion R8870 images from DECODE with the session cookie.
76/77 groups distinct; character IoC x 35 about 1.12, near flat.
Viewed all 26 DECODE key records of Add MS 32280 (R8890, R8894-R8919) for a trigram letter code.

outcome.method_basis: The 77 three-character groups of Add MS 32280 f. 3 were transcribed; they are too flat and too short to rebuild a code, and none of the volume's 26 DECODE key records uses this system.
outcome.notes: Too short to rebuild a code; needs the key or the rest of the numbered series (No 13 onwards), probably in unimaged ff. 4-54.
